decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period of three years when the wall hereby permitted shall be removed in order to allow the implementation of approved scheme 00707/E/P91.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Sample panels of brickwork showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointin gshall be provided on site and approved by the LPA before the works are commenced and the sample panels shlall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.

Condition : 4 - Full details of the proposed feather edged boards shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA prior to commencement of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 5 - The lower glazing bar to windows EW06 and 07 shown on drawing number 01175B is considered unsatisfactory and this aspect of the scheme should be modified to show no glazing bars to ensure an acceptable form of development.
description: Temporary consent for the erection of external wall to proposed visitor centre to enable phased completion pursuant to consents no's 00707/E/P91 and 00707/E/L20.
